slices.label: LCA; line-graph oracle baseline
slices.task: Return one edge color per queried edge, consistently with a single proper coloring
assumptions: Input supplied via adjacency-neighbor oracle to the line graph L(G), whose vertices are the original edges; N=m and degree 2≤D≤2Δ−2 (trivial D<2 cases omitted)
Deterministic oblivious LCA, no state retained between queries; edge identifiers supplied in the oracle

yAxis.label: Probe ladder in Δ (per answered query)

parameters.D: maximum degree of the line graph

results.bound: D^{O(√D log^(5/2)D)} log* m line-graph oracle probes per query
results.guarantee: Proper q=D+1 vertex coloring of L(G), hence q≤2Δ−1 edge coloring of G
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 5.1 (l/d>D) instantiated with l=D+1,d=1 on L(G); Section 5
results.notes: This is a direct line-graph specialization of a primary theorem, not an author-stated edge-LCA SOTA claim. Probe accounting assumes direct line-graph adjacency access, and must not be transferred to ordinary G-neighbor or matrix oracles without simulation overhead.
